entries.title: Cards show which questions you may skip and what a skip sends
entries.body: On a card that asks several questions, an optional question now tags its suggested option Default instead of Recommended, and draws a hollow ring on it until you pick something there. The footer counts how many questions still need your answer and how many defaults a click would send, and the crewmate reads each skipped question as the default it sent.

picture.alt: A card with four questions: the required one tagged Recommended, three optional ones tagged Default with hollow rings, and a footer reading 1 to answer · 3 defaults
